 Brewers' Trevor Megill Blasts 'F--king Idiot' Who Designed Roof of Rays' Stadium Amid World Series
 Timothy Rapp Oct 25, 2026 It's safe to say that Trevor Megill isn't a fan of Tropicana Field. 
 The Milwaukee Brewers closer had some thoughts on the Tampa Bay Rays' home having a roof that's painted white, the same color as a baseball:

 Bleacher Report 12m Megill complaining about a quirky roof is a bit ironic, however, given that American Family Field's roof cables literally robbed San Diego Padres' first baseman Ty France of a potential game-winning home run during the ninth inning of Game 1 of the NLDS.
 Instead, left-fielderJackson Chourio caught the ball after it careened back to the field and it was ruled an out. The Brewers ultimately won the game, 3-2. 
 Ballpark quirks have long been a part of the sport. Tropicana Field isn't alone in that regard.
